process.headline: Four steps. No surprises.
process.lead: What everyone worries about with a made-to-measure product is how much hassle it will be. This is the whole route, with the real timings.

mides.desc: You come to the store or we come to you with the sample book. We measure the window and look at the light it gets at each hour of the day.

workshop.paragraph2: We do one thing and we do it well: dressing homes with made-to-measure textiles. Every project starts with a conversation and ends with an installation carried out by our own team.

faq.headline: What we get asked every day.

cost.a: No. Measuring in store and the quote are free and carry no obligation whatsoever. The only service with a fee is the home advisory visit with the sample book, and we deduct it from the order if you go ahead.

termini.q: How long from the moment I say yes?
termini.a: Between two and three weeks of making, plus the installation day. If you have a fixed date — a move, the start of a rental season — say so from the outset and we will work to it.

domicili.q: Do you come to the house to measure?
domicili.a: Yes. We bring the sample book so you can see the fabrics in your own space and your own light, which is where it is really decided. That is the home advisory service.

installacio.a: Our own team. We do not subcontract the fitting: whoever takes the measurements and whoever hangs the curtain work for the same house, and that is why the measurements add up.

zona.a: The whole province of Girona and the Costa Brava, from our stores in Girona, Blanes and Palamós. If you are outside that area, ask anyway.

garantia.q: And if something goes wrong later?
garantia.a: We take care of it ourselves. We have been on the same street for sixty-five years, and the customer who comes back is exactly what keeps us open.
